headline: United's hubs are running normally; a delay program is slowing Seattle arrivals.

items.text: The seven United hubs reporting so far today are at 84% on time or better, and the network status is Smooth Ops.

No FAA ground stop or ground delay program is in effect at any United hub, and weather is not affecting operations at any of the 9 United hubs with a current report. A ground delay program is in effect for flights into Seattle (SEA) until 9:59 PM PT, with delays averaging 32 minutes, up to 82 minutes.
The FAA's operations plan lists a possible ground stop or ground delay program for flights into Newark (EWR) tomorrow after 10:00 AM ET. It is not in effect.

traveler_note.text: If you are flying into Seattle, check your flight status before leaving for the airport, since the ground delay program there runs until 9:59 PM PT.
